related_records.label: carbon fixation by 3-hydroxypropionate cycle
related_records.reason: First Chloroflexus 3-hydroxypropionate cycle fixes inorganic carbon to glyoxylate and regenerates acetyl-CoA. Four shared families are the malyl-CoA lyase/PCC/epimerase/mutase context, not the full ethylmalonyl acetyl-CoA assimilation route.

related_records.label: Dicarboxylate-hydroxybutyrate cycle
related_records.reason: Dicarboxylate/4-hydroxybutyrate fixation cycle has fourteen reactions but shares only thiolase family21036; identity, route intermediates and net output differ. Equal reaction counts do not establish a duplicate.

related_records.label: glyoxylate assimilation
related_records.reason: Second Chloroflexus glyoxylate-assimilation cycle converts glyoxylate to pyruvate with carrier regeneration. Two mesaconyl/beta-methylmalyl families overlap, not the ethylmalonyl acetyl-CoA-to-malate/succinyl-CoA route.

related_records.label: 3-hydroxypropanoate/4-hydroxybutanate cycle
related_records.reason: Archaeal 3-hydroxypropionate/4-hydroxybutyrate fixation cycle shares four branch/thiolase families; its S-hydroxybutyryl regeneration, carbon boundary and complete reaction scope differ.

related_records.label: polyhydroxybutanoate biosynthesis
related_records.reason: PHB biosynthesis shares thiolase and R-hydroxybutyryl reduction then polymerizes the monomer. No complete ethylmalonyl carbon-assimilation route.

related_records.label: conversion of succinate to propanoate
related_records.reason: Sbm/ScpABC three-enzyme succinate-to-propanoate cycle shares the methylmalonyl-CoA mutase family; it includes decarboxylation and CoA transfer rather than the complete fourteen-step candidate.

related_records.label: mevalonate pathway
related_records.reason: Seven-step yeast mevalonate route shares acetyl-CoA C-acetyltransferase but proceeds through HMG-CoA/mevalonate to isopentenyl/prenyl diphosphate, not ethylmalonyl-CoA, malate and succinyl-CoA.
